verdict.rationale: There is no direct cap-table migration feature in the evidence. The closest support is indirect: workflows offer an 'upload' path to capture previously signed documents (docs-19), and some workflows can record past changes (docs-36). Those records are smart-linked to the cap table and data room (docs-7, docs-34), which gives a document-backed way to rebuild history. Bulk upload exists only for equity promises (docs-4), not for full cap table data. Missing for 10: a guided spreadsheet or other-platform cap table import, validation of imported data, explicit reconciliation tooling against source documents, migration-specific docs, and independent corroboration.
